# [TASK] Evaluate major-version Dependabot bumps: MUI 6→9, ESLint 7→10 dev-deps

## Task
Two Dependabot PRs landed against `main` on 2026-08-09 bumping frontend/filmpire
dependencies by multiple major versions, not routine patch/minor bumps:
- PR #133 — `@mui/material` and `@mui/icons-material` 6.5.0 → 9.3.1 (3 majors)
- PR #134 — dev-dependencies group: `eslint` 7.32.0 → 10.8.0, `eslint-config-airbnb`
  18.2.1 → 19.0.4, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` 4.6.2 → 7.1.1, `@babel/eslint-parser`
  and `@babel/preset-react` 7.29.7 → 8.0.1

Given the size of the jump (MUI 5→6 alone was its own dedicated migration Task,
#130), these are not safe to merge as-is — MUI's Grid API and several component
props changed across major versions, and ESLint 9+ requires flat config
(`eslint.config.js`), a breaking change from the current `.eslintrc`. Both needed
actual evaluation, a decision, and a full test/lint pass before merging, matching
the precedent set by #130.

## Scope
- In scope: assessing breaking changes in both PRs, migrating code, verifying
  build/lint/tests, merging.
- Out of scope: any other dependency bumps not covered by #133/#134.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] MUI 6→9 breaking changes inventoried against actual `frontend/filmpire` usage
      (Grid, deprecated props, etc.)
- [x] ESLint 7→10 flat-config migration path decided (migrate to
      `eslint.config.js` or pin ESLint back, whichever fits the repo's Sprint bandwidth)
      — **decided: pin back to latest 8.x** (`eslint-config-airbnb` has no ESLint
      9/10 or flat-config support even in its latest release; see Notes)
- [x] Frontend builds, lints, and full test suite passes after migration
- [x] PR #133 and #134 merged (or superseded by a hand-migrated commit that
      supersedes each PR's diff), each referencing this Task — **both closed as
      superseded** (not merged as-is; see Notes)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6 (both chunks complete)

## Notes

**MUI 6 to 9** (commit `ffa3fc8`): bumped to 9.3.1 using the official `@mui/codemod` transforms. `PlayCircleOutline` was removed in v9, replaced with `PlayCircleOutlineOutlined`.

**ESLint 7 to 10: not possible.** `eslint-config-airbnb@19.0.4` supports ESLint 7/8 only and has never shipped flat-config support. Decision (commit `a7e83f5`): pin ESLint to 8.57.1, keep `.eslintrc.js`, bump airbnb to 19.0.4 and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` to 4.6.2. Dropping airbnb to unblock ESLint 10 is a separate, ruleset-changing task.

The newer rules surfaced three real fixes: 21 arrow-function components converted to declarations, an unsafe optional chain in `Profile.jsx`, and a constructed context value in `ToggleColorMode.jsx`.

PRs #133 and #134 closed as superseded.
